topic.title: 알레르기 증상 상담하기
topic.description: 이 콘텐츠는 알레르기 증상으로 병원을 방문했을 때 의사에게 자신의 상태를 설명하는 방법을 배웁니다. 초급 학습자를 위한 기본적인 의료 대화 연습입니다.

korean_scripts.korean_text: 안녕하세요, 의사 선생님. 제가 알레르기 증상이 좀 있어서요.
며칠 전부터 콧물이 나고 눈이 가려워요.
혹시 무엇 때문에 심해지는 것 같으신가요?
밖에 나가면 더 심해지는 것 같아서, 아마 꽃가루 때문인 것 같아요.
네, 알겠습니다. 우선 체온이랑 혈압을 재 볼게요.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Hello, doctor. I've been having some allergy symptoms.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Hello, doctor. | I've been having some allergy symptoms.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. What seems to be the problem?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. | What seems to be the problem?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I've had a runny nose and itchy eyes for a few days.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I've had a runny nose | and itchy eyes for a few days.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Have you noticed anything that might be causing it?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Have you noticed anything | that might be causing it?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I think it might be pollen, as it's worse when I go outside.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I think it might be pollen, | as it's worse when I go outside.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Okay, I'll take a look. Let's check your temperature and blood pressure first.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Okay, I'll take a look. | Let's check your temperature | and blood pressure first.
